summary: But you are right @CrazyQuilts Open Source is one of the whitest and malest of all the tech sectors. Sad that the tools for liberation reflect our inequities, but I guess #literacies have always worked this way. The Web is not different.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
But you are right @CrazyQuilts Open Source is one of the whitest and malest of all the tech sectors. Sad that the tools for liberation reflect our inequities, but I guess #literacies have always worked this way.

The Web is not different.
